suggestions: replace intersect with union all and group by
introduce channel column for distinct count
move customer join to outer query
optimized_sql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, u.d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, sd.d_date AS d_date, 's' AS channel
        FROM store_sales
        JOIN date_dim sd ON sd.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
        WHERE sd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
        GROUP BY ss_customer_sk, sd.d_date
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cd.d_date AS d_date, 'c' AS channel
        FROM catalog_sales
        JOIN date_dim cd ON cd.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk
        WHERE cd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
        GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk, cd.d_date
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, wd.d_date AS d_date, 'w' AS channel
        FROM web_sales
        JOIN date_dim wd ON wd.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk
        WHERE wd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
        GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk, wd.d_date
    ) u
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = u.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, u.d_date
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.channel) = 3
) x
LIMIT 100
